b: A look back at what we were talking about around this time in previous years:
how soon can I take leave from a new job for in-patient alcoholism treatment?
my employer has taken all flexibility out of working from home, and people are upset
my coworker is dating a teenager
I just found out my BFF has been my employee’s therapist for years
is my girlfriend’s CEO hitting on her?
was it reasonable to fire a new hire who was too overwhelmed to work on day 3?
my company insists on shipping wine to our homes and I can’t opt out
my rich friend is oblivious when he talks about money … and I’m at a breaking point
my employee times her bathroom breaks to avoid the tasks she doesn’t want to do
my coworker wants me to do all the work he sends me ASAP, even when I have higher priorities
my coworker accidentally sent me an email complaining about me
how can I take time off when my team needs it more?
my coworker keeps joking that I’m having sex with my husband in the office
my employee refuses to lie to customers — but that’s our policy
I didn’t know my former coworker was so disliked and now I’m worried
my boss keeps inviting herself to my house
one of the managers who reports to me only hires conventionally attractive people
my coworker wants to find the office pooper — and it’s me
my dad wants to apply for a job on my very small team
my office wants us to chip in to send our CEO’s family on a ski trip
